findings.location: askme.py step loop: commit_executed increments before execute() reports failure

findings.location: askme.py replan-state builder: _WRITE_TASK_RE runs on the full user prompt, steps are task-scoped
findings.impact: benign for this canary (the entire frozen problem statement is implement-shaped) but the flag can fire on failed observation-only tasks

findings.location: askme.py _WRITE_TASK_RE: matches include/add/update in any grammatical role
findings.impact: exploration tasks worded with these verbs are treated as write-shaped; write-pressure and tail-reserve firing counts may include spurious firings on observation tasks
